title: Design Engineer Mechanical - Energy Conversion
description: Your role As a design engineer mechanical, your mission is to translate customer needs into tailored compressor, dryer, and accessory solutions. In this role, you report to the Team Leader Mechanical Design and play a key part in delivering reliable and efficient technical solutions. You develop and evaluate technical alternatives, identify potential risks, and select the most effective solution for each project. You are responsible for designing and modifying technical drawings and parts lists, writing procedures, and ensuring the safety and quality of your designs through thorough risk analyses. Throughout the production process, you support technicians, help resolve technical issues, and validate the work of peers to ensure consistent quality. You collaborate closely with suppliers in coordination with the purchasing manager, as well as with competence carriers and various internal teams to achieve the best possible results. In addition, you support the quotation team by translating specifications into machine requirements and selecting the appropriate components. Working closely with the project team, you contribute to compressor designs, promote standardization, and ensure centralized data sharing within the Global Engineering team. To succeed, you will need At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position. A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering. Knowledge of CAD systems (Inventor/AutoCAD) and ENOVIA. Good command of English (written and spoken). Affinity for mechanical design and product optimization. Initiative, problem-solving mindset, and team spirit. In return, we offer At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning. You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits. Job location Hybrid This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our premises in Wilrijk. Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.
